name: @gopractice/goreview-ios
description: Capacitor iOS shell for the bundled GoReview edition

scripts.sync:ios: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs --developer && cap sync ios && node scripts/verify-native-payload.mjs ios/App/App/public
scripts.release:sync: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs --release && cap sync ios && node scripts/verify-native-payload.mjs ios/App/App/public --release
